verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications SaaS with apps and an API, so an opt-out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or privacy settings. The items present cover API auth, rate limits, the MCP server, pricing, and features, none of which are about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
